value: At Thalorien’s resting place, the Wrath quest sets a new seeker against a trial and a memory of the fallen knight. This encounter does not undo his death or make him a living participant in the restoration. His blessing links the blade’s old bearer to its present burden. The story holds both moments apart: Thalorien fell at the Sunwell in the Third War; a later test asks whether the seeker is worthy to carry his memory onward.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
